forms:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for a 2D side scrolling game. Exactly FOUR separate complete figures in one horizontal row, equally spaced with transparent gaps, same character scale, feet on common baseline. True transparent PNG alpha background, no labels, no grid, no floor. Crisp 16-bit pixel art with chunky pixels and dark outlines, readable at 54x64 pixels.
Character: Brazilian adult male teacher with medium brown skin, short dark hair, no glasses.
Frame 1: RomerBug formal clothing, navy suit jacket and trousers, white shirt, dark red tie, brown formal shoes, standing facing RIGHT, holding a small white paper airplane ready to throw.
Frame 2: SAME RomerBug in SAME formal outfit and proportions, throwing arm extended forward to RIGHT in paper airplane release pose.
Frame 3: SAME man transformed to SpeedBug, wearing orange running singlet, dark running shorts, white running sneakers, a gold medal with a short blue ribbon at chest. Full-body running contact pose facing RIGHT, one leg forward and other back, elbows bent.
Frame 4: SAME SpeedBug in exactly same running outfit, opposite running stride, legs exchanging position, elbows bent. Preserve facial identity and scale.
Exactly four bodies, no extra objects outside figures, opaque character interiors and genuinely transparent surroundings. Each full figure entirely inside its quarter of the wide canvas.
projectiles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two projectile sprites for a 16-bit pixel art platform game. Exactly two isolated objects side by side on true transparent PNG alpha background. Left: a white folded PAPER AIRPLANE flying nose to the RIGHT, side view, triangular silhouette with dark navy outline and light blue folds, readable at 26x14 pixels. Right: a round GOLD running medal with raised star and a short BLUE ribbon loop connected to the coin, readable at 18x22 pixels. Each object centered in its own half, generous empty transparent margins, no text, no numbers, no labels, no grid, no background, no ground shadows, no glow. Crisp chunky pixel art matching dark-outlined platform characters.
